meta.scope: Whole-project sweep across robustness/security, gameplay loop, and speed/test infrastructure, after S204 baseline (lint, suite, build) found the local suite red on one spawn-budget fixture (already fixed in 15c6295).
meta.baseline: 15c6295 on main and canonical production; 303/303 files, 2135/2135 tests, strict lint and build green
meta.method: Three read-only subagent sweeps (robustness/security, gameplay loop, speed/test infra). Every finding below was re-read by the author against live files before inclusion; nothing is included on an agent's word alone.

gameLoopReview.loopTightness: No loop defect found that survived verification; the gameplay sweep is recorded under items only if verified.
gameLoopReview.sessionEngagement: Stale leaderboard and profile reads are the player-visible risk: a player who just beat the top 10 can be shown the old board.
gameLoopReview.soulFidelity: Proof over posture: caches must not contradict the server's own no-store promise.

meta.verification: Gameplay items 6-7 came from a third subagent sweep and were re-read by the author in App.jsx before inclusion. A fourth subagent reviewed the diff independently: approve, with nits applied (byte-length cap, comment wording, lint-ignore scope).

items.title: Service worker must not cache same-origin /api/* responses
items.why: public/sw.js:97-110 applies cache-first stale-while-revalidate to every same-origin GET under BASE. /api/profile and /api/duel-preview send cache-control: no-store, and /api/top-scores and /api/community-stats send max-age=0, yet the worker replays the first cached copy. The cache key is the URL only, so an authenticated /api/profile read is shared across whoever uses the browser next.
items.recipe: Return before respondWith for pathnames under `${BASE}api/` and for `/_health`; make cacheResponse refuse responses whose Cache-Control contains no-store or private; bump CACHE_NAME so existing poisoned entries are purged on activate. Add a unit test that executes sw.js against a fake self/caches and asserts /api requests are never answered from cache.

premises.claim: The shell branch caches every path under BASE including /api

L1.recipe: Skip /api/ in the fetch handler only.

L2.recipe: L1 plus no-store/private refusal in cacheResponse, cache version bump, and an executable worker test.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a Playwright check that a second /api/top-scores read reaches the network.

executionLog: public/sw.js: /api/* and /_health bypass, no-store/private responses never stored, CACHE_NAME cod-v6 to cod-v7. tests/service-worker-boundary.test.js runs the real worker in a sandbox: 4 of 5 fail without the fix. Staging real-Chrome probe: worker controlling, cache cod-v7, /api/top-scores and /api/community-stats not in cache, network hit on every read.

items.title: Service worker same-origin test must compare origins, not substrings
items.why: public/sw.js:60 uses url.origin.includes(self.location.origin). With origin http://localhost:5173 a request to http://localhost:51730 passes, and a lookalike host that contains the production origin as a prefix would pass the same test and be cached under the shared cache name.
items.recipe: Replace with url.origin !== self.location.origin. Covered by the item 1 worker test.

premises.claim: Origin check is a substring test

L2.recipe: L1 plus a lookalike-origin assertion in the worker test.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a CSP review of connect-src.

executionLog: url.origin !== self.location.origin; covered by lookalike-origin assertions (callofdoodie.wtf.evil.example, localhost:51730).

items.title: submit-score and sync-game-run return 400, not a leaky 500, on a malformed body
items.why: submit-score/index.ts:319 and sync-game-run/index.ts:93 call req.json() unguarded. A body of `null` or non-JSON throws; the outer catch (submit-score:613-619) returns status 500 with the raw error.message, e.g. "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'runToken')". That is a client error reported as a server error, discloses internals, and runs after rate-limit budget is spent. The browser client treats 5xx as retryable (src/storage.js).
items.recipe: Parse with .catch(() => null); if the result is not a plain object return 400 {error:"Invalid JSON body."}. Extract the guard as a small pure helper with a Node-runnable test so it is covered without Deno.

L2.recipe: Shared pure helper plus unit test, both functions use it.

L3.recipe: L2 plus redeploy and a live malformed-body probe against staging.

executionLog: readJsonObject in _shared/http-trust.ts used by submit-score and sync-game-run. Live before: 500 with raw TypeError/parser text. Live after deploy to project fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp: 400 Invalid JSON body. for null/non-JSON; {} still reaches the real validation. Deno check: sync-game-run clean; submit-score 7 pre-existing supabase-js generic errors, identical with the change stashed.

items.title: validate-replay must cap the body it stores and stop echoing error text
items.why: validate-replay/index.ts:231 reads an unbounded body and :242 stores it verbatim as run_anomalies.payload for every failing request, and the catch at :253 returns "internal: " + err.message. At the 30/min limit a caller can write large payloads into the table; the limiter itself fails open when its RPC throws.
items.recipe: Read text, reject over 20 KB with 413, parse with a guard, and store only a bounded subset (mode, a few scalar fields) in payload. Replace the echoed message with a fixed reason.

premises.claim: Whole body is stored as the anomaly payload

L1.recipe: Size cap and fixed error reason.

L2.recipe: L1 plus bounded payload subset and helper test.

L3.recipe: L2 plus fail-closed behaviour when the rate RPC throws, which changes an intentional advisory design and needs a decision.

executionLog: validate-replay: 32 KB cap (413 live), bounded anomaly payload without the trace body, fixed internal reason. Live: 40 KB body 413; valid-shaped request 200 ok:true. Rate-limit fail-closed (L3) deliberately not done: it changes an intentional advisory design and needs a decision.

items.title: Hoist per-frame literals and cache viewport-only gradients in drawGame.js
items.why: src/drawGame.js:389 and :687 build nested array literals each frame, :1057 creates a gradient per bullet, and four fullscreen vignette gradients depend only on W and H. Plausible but unmeasured: no profile shows these in the frame budget.
items.recipe: Capture a CDP trace first. Hoist :389 and :687 like the existing CROC_SCALE_DOTS pattern only if the trace shows allocation pressure.
items.deferralReason: Token and speed items need a measurement plan (audit hard rule). No frame-time evidence exists, and changing render code without it risks the visual-parity gates for an unproven gain.

L2.recipe: L1 plus offscreen vignette cache keyed on size.

L3.recipe: L2 plus per-bullet gradient replacement and a before/after CDP trace.

items.title: Scavenger / Bullet Hose must not shrink the pickup refill of the held weapon
items.why: App.jsx ammo pickup: with ammoRestoreMult > 1 the full refill was replaced by floor(max*0.30*mult) on every weapon, so an empty held weapon got +39% instead of 100% while the copy promised more ammo and the popup still said MAX AMMO.
items.recipe: Extract the rule to systems/ammoPickup.js: held weapon always full refill, perk adds a top-up to the other weapons.
executionLog: systems/ammoPickup.js + 4 unit tests (never-less-than-plain test fails on the old rule); App.jsx call site; launch test still passes.

items.title: Rematch drill wave must be sized with the seed's double_trouble modifier
items.why: App.jsx sized the first drill wave before the run-modifier switch set waveEnemyMult = 2, so a double_trouble seed practiced wave 7 at 26 enemies instead of the 52 the player faced.
items.recipe: rematchWaveMultForModifier(modifierId) read from RUN_MODIFIERS[seed % len] when sizing the drill wave.
executionLog: rematchDrill.js helper + tests; App.jsx call site. The call site itself is not exercised by a test (reviewer nit, accepted).

rejected.claim: Navigation responses are cached without an ok check
rejected.reason: The cached navigation entry is never read; the fallback only matches index.html. No effect.

rejected.claim: Convert spawn-heavy script tests to in-process imports
rejected.reason: Four target scripts execute at import time with no exported main(); the refactor is larger than the saved time and several tests are legitimate CLI exit-code tests. Revisit only with a duration ratchet.
